title: 程序员每周十句
disclaimer: 整理自 fltenwall/The-English-For-Programmer（MIT）《互联网人的英语私教课》每周一起背10句，致谢原作者与课程。

words.word: don t jump to conclusions perhaps it was his daughter he was dancing with
words.gloss: 别匆忙下结论，和他跳舞的没准是他女儿呢。

words.word: the workers approached the manager with a request for shorter working hours
words.gloss: 工人们找经理要求减少工作时间。

words.word: his sober approach to the crisis averted a catastrophe
words.gloss: 他对危机的冷静处理避免了一场大灾难。

words.word: you need to work hard opportunities don t just come out of thin air
words.gloss: 你得努力啦，机会不会凭空产生（天上不会掉馅饼）。

words.word: social media technologies have given companies access to an unprecedented flood of new analytics metrics and user data
words.gloss: 有了社交网络之后，企业获取了空前大量的新分析方法、度量指标和用户数据。

words.word: steve jobs was a gifted communicator and he used this skill to capture the attention of millions
words.gloss: 乔布斯是一个有天赋的沟通者，他用这种技巧吸引了数百万人的注意力。

words.word: apple will unveil a inch touchscreen tablet device in january and ship the product in march
words.gloss: 苹果将于一月份推出10英寸触屏平板电脑，并于三月份发货。

words.word: we define an iteration as a phase or a milestone
words.gloss: 我们将一次迭代定义为一个阶段或一个里程碑。

words.word: her husband was unsympathetic and she felt she had no one to turn to
words.gloss: 她的丈夫不懂得体恤人，她觉得无人可以依靠。

words.word: life is full of trade offs you cannot have your cake and eat it too
words.gloss: 生活充满了取舍。鱼和熊掌不可兼得。

words.word: point break was a breakout film for kathryn bigelow in
words.gloss: 凯瑟琳·毕格罗于1991年拍摄了《惊爆点》，该片突破了她之前的风格。

words.word: i have little knowledge of computer and business can i still learn navisio
words.gloss: 我对计算机和商业知之甚少，我还能学习Navision系统吗？

words.word: i was juggling books shopping bags and the baby
words.gloss: 我手里又是书，又是购物袋，还抱着孩子，跟演杂技一样。

words.word: my computer keeps going funny
words.gloss: 我的计算机老出故障。

words.word: what jock had done was beyond my comprehension
words.gloss: 我无法理解乔克的所作所为。

words.word: major breakthroughs have been made in the reform of china s ownership structure
words.gloss: 中国所有制结构改革也取得了重大突破。

words.word: they bring suggestions and tradeoffs to the table some of which are included in the revised spec
words.gloss: 他们会提供建议和取舍方案，其中某些建议会反映在修订后的产品设计规范中。

words.word: after each project their product understanding deepens and they start to develop better and better product instincts
words.gloss: 每完成一个项目，他们对产品的理解就会加深，他们开始培养起越来越好的产品直觉。

words.word: children do not know by instinct the difference between right and wrong
words.gloss: 儿童并非生来就会分辨是非。

words.word: tell us what you bring to the table not just what you want
words.gloss: 告诉我们你能给公司带来什么，而不仅仅是你想要什么。

words.word: i don t see the relevance of your question
words.gloss: 我不懂你提的这个问题有什么意义。（口气非常强烈甚至不礼貌）

words.word: all happy families resemble one another each unhappy family is unhappy in its own way
words.gloss: 幸福的家庭都是相似的，不幸的家庭各有各的不幸。

words.word: although i don t like him i agree he is a good manager
words.gloss: 虽然我不喜欢他，但我承认他是一个出色的经理人。

words.word: i m sorry i think sleep deprivation contributed to my outburst just then
words.gloss: 抱歉，睡眠不足让我刚才情绪失控了。

words.word: the second benefit is teams ability to safely experiment and fail fast
words.gloss: 第二个好处是团队能够安全地进行实验并获得“快速失败”的能力。

words.word: i empowered my agent to close the deal
words.gloss: 我授权我的经纪人完成这笔交易。

words.word: the third benefit open source offers is a better way of building software
words.gloss: 开源的第三个好处是提高软件开发质量。

words.word: this led to software developers taking more care in the software they were writing
words.gloss: 这也使得软件开发人员在编写软件时更加用心。

words.word: open source is evolving at a rapid pace and developers learn new open source technologies every few years
words.gloss: 开源软件发展迅猛，开发人员每隔几年就要学习新的开源技术。

words.word: establishing a high level of trust among remote managers and employees starts with having good meeting rituals
words.gloss: 在远程工作过程中，经理和员工之间的高度信任始于一套良好的会议仪式。

words.word: managers must lead by example because what you do is more important than what you say
words.gloss: 经理们必须以身作则，因为你的行动比你的言辞更重要。

words.word: joe left my house around pm and was hit by a car about minutes later
words.gloss: 乔下午五点左右离开我家，大约三十分钟后就被车撞了。

words.word: while remote work is very appealing to some employees it does come with some trade offs
words.gloss: 虽然远程工作对一些员工来说很有吸引力，但也一定有得有失。

words.word: pets exercise and getting into nature can also help improve mental well being
words.gloss: 养宠物、运动和融入大自然也可以帮助改善心理健康。

words.word: several demonstrators broke through the barriers despite warnings from the police
words.gloss: 几名示威者不顾警方的警告，冲破了封锁线。

words.word: statistics disprove the myth that women are worse drivers than men
words.gloss: 统计数据驳斥了女司机不如男司机的成见。

words.word: ill health often goes with poverty
words.gloss: 疾病往往伴随贫困而来。

words.word: what are the responsibilities that goes with becoming a father
words.gloss: 成为父亲之后要承担哪些责任？

words.word: this wine goes particularly well with seafood
words.gloss: 这款葡萄酒特别适合搭配海鲜。

words.word: the music doesn t go with the mood of the film
words.gloss: 配乐和这部电影的基调不搭。

words.word: many employees complain that their bosses are poor communicators and bad at giving clear instructions
words.gloss: 很多员工抱怨他们老板不善于沟通，无法下达明确的指令。

words.word: he emphasized that managers had to be more communicative with their staff
words.gloss: 他强调，管理人员要加强与员工的沟通交流。

words.word: the test evaluates students communicative skills
words.gloss: 该项测试主要考核学生的沟通能力。

words.word: my daughter is very difficult uncommunicative and moody
words.gloss: 我女儿很难相处，不愿跟人交流，又非常情绪化。

words.word: the bill drew support from across the political spectrum
words.gloss: 该项法案赢得了各政治派别的支持。

words.word: the two articles here represent opposite ends of the spectrum
words.gloss: 这两篇文章代表着截然不同的两派观点。

words.word: we think that outside china alibaba will struggle to gain traction as will oracle salesforce and sap
words.gloss: 我们认为，在中国以外的地区，阿里巴巴将努力争取获得更多客户的认可，甲骨文、Salesforce和SAP也是如此。
